metaTitle: Sheng Ji Before Major Decisions: Due Diligence and Limits
metaDescription: Planning an IPO, acquisition or major bid? Treat Sheng Ji as a cultural service, verify its terms in writing, and base decisions on legal, financial and commercial evidence.

h1: Sheng Ji before a major decision: check the service, protect the decision
heroSub: No deal outcome or response time is guaranteed · Use professional due diligence first

sections.h2: Keep business decisions grounded in evidence

items.h3: A ceremony cannot secure a deal
items.content: An IPO, acquisition, bid or financing round depends on legal requirements, finances, counterparties, timing and market conditions. No traditional ritual can guarantee an approval, contract, valuation or closing date.

Rely on legal, accounting, investment and commercial advice appropriate to the decision. A cultural service may have personal meaning, but it must not replace due diligence or become the reason to accept a poor deal.
Before paying, confirm the service provider, practitioner, location, site permission, schedule and video or other delivery records in writing.

The published five-year price is RMB 72,000 and the lifetime price is RMB 500,000, with a RMB 10,000 deposit and the remaining balance due under the selected plan. Confirm upgrade differences, rescheduling and refund terms in writing.
Traditional date selection does not establish when, or whether, a business outcome will change. Do not treat a transaction deadline as a reason to skip verification or pay immediately.
